messages:
anna: Quick follow-up from the retro: we keep seeing three recurring vendor failure modes (cloud control-plane flaps, model-registry rate limits, auth refresh storms). Need owners + measurable mitigations. Can folks pick up items?
ben: Ill take cloud control-plane. Short plan: region-aware routing + token-bucket client throttling + test harness to simulate control-plane 5xx bursts. ETA: 9 working days.
carol: Ill own the auth-provider work. Short-term: jittered token refresh, small local TTL cache, and secondary provider failover. Blocking: need KMS rotation window from security.
liam: Ill handle model-registry throttles. Plan: prefetch hot artifacts, read-only fallback using last-known-good, and client backpressure. Canary: 10% staging -> 10% prod -> evaluate after 48h.
devops-bot: Created epic INF-9400: "vendor-deps-hardening" with checklist. Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-9400. Default due date: 2027-06-01.
anna: Owners please add 1-line subtasks to INF-9400 by EOD Friday and include success metrics (target P99 spike reduction + incident frequency goal). Also add rollback steps and oncall rotation in runbooks.
ben: Adding fallback snippet to the epic:
```json
{"fallback_order":["local-cache","registry-readonly","proxy-degrade"],"retries":{"max":3,"backoff_ms":[150,450,900]}}
```
carol: Vendor SLA request sent to auth-vendor@partner.example asking for burst windows, escalation path, and a test token endpoint.
liam: I'll add cron pre-warm at 03:00 UTC for hot models and measure memory delta. If cost impact >7% we flag a tradeoff.
anna: Agree on success criteria: >=40% fewer P99 spikes and <=1 incident/month within 45 days post-rollout. Mike (ops) will own telemetry dashboards.
devops-bot: Reminder: INF-9400 has unestimated subtasks. Please add estimates.
ben: I'll add a small chaos test that injects control-plane 10% error rate and validates fallback within 5s.
anna: Thanks all. We'll do a 20m sync next Tue to confirm blockers. Keep details in the epic, short notes here. :thumbsup:
